sources.title: I Tested 70 AI Models on DAX - Here's What Actually Works
sources.snippet: I spent the past few months building DAXBench—a systematic evaluation of 70 different AI models on their ability to write DAX formulas for Power BI. The goal was simple: figure out which AI assistants actually work for DAX, and which ones waste your time with code that looks right but won't compile.
